description: Both native EditorSessions preserve admission -> latch -> cancel -> drain -> commit -> effect. Their shared statement is the per-note mailbox: tagged change generation >= edited watermark means current, otherwise one bounded flush wait. Both shells commit the latest delivered document; navigation commit order and move-picker drain timing remain specified divergences. Rust owns the meaning of persistence through flush_draft/persist-or-park. Each shell's ordering and mailbox unit tests pin the invariants; both hosts and docs/spec/editor.md move together.
